items.text: on a big screen the panels above the bar grow with their contents, so Auto play shows everything without a scrollbar

the controls are sized to the window: the bar follows the window's shorter side, so a short, wide window gives the stage more room and a big monitor gets bigger buttons; shelves and panels keep their proportions with it. Phones look as they did
Settings › Size: Small, Medium or Large controls on this device, for zoom, a projector across the room, or eyesight
the self-test report says what the device saw: window, pixel ratio, finger or mouse, the size in use
Pulse is now React, where the shelf's REACT pill leads: tap it to switch React on or off, hold it (or drag up) for its panel
React's own amounts in its panel: how much louder is faster, and how much harder each beat pushes (this device's)
Surge, Breathe and Sway each have their wave (Auto) in the React panel: a sine or any shape gives them a motion of their own
a die in the React panel's head rolls Surge, Breathe and Sway now, and sometimes their waves; it rolls what is ticked, the same ticks as Random › Pulse
Audience waits backstage until its relay is online; the room where phones join is not ready yet

on iPhone the page could be closed while you played: the share card, drawn ahead of time a few seconds after opening, held on to about 240 MB of drawing it no longer needed; it now lets go of it at once
a scene's ground no longer changes the interface's accent; the teal stays teal on every ground and through a morph (it had flipped to black when a ground turned colored, sometimes mid-animation)

what is chosen in a shelf is lit with the teal wash behind it, like the pills of the bottom shelf (WET, REACT, TOUCH…); on the light theme its darkened teal label had been almost the black of the others
in the Random matrix, Roll now is a round dice button at the top, at the end of how much changes; at the foot of the Roll tab it hid below the lists
What's new marks a Pro item with its padlock alone, without saying so in words

with Increase Contrast on (iPhone: Settings › Accessibility › Display & Text Size), the accent becomes ink on the light theme and white on the dark one; the sound's draining bar stays white inside its dark body, so it never reads dark grey on black
Pulse
the list of what's new marks Pro items with the padlock, open while that feature is in the beta
on a phone, the last button you tapped in a shelf no longer turns white (a leftover hover that looked like a third state); lit in the accent is on, ink is off
in the Color tool's row, the mixer pinned at the end is solid, so the colors scrolling under it no longer read through its glass (ARROWS showed through MIXER)
the Random matrix has tabs: Roll (how much changes, what Auto rolls from, roll now), then Field, Pulse, Color, and Lens & Auto, each with its own list of what rolls
Surge and Breathe can roll too, in the matrix's Pulse tab beside Sway, Magnet and Lag; they stay out until you tick them, so a roll never starts the field pulsing unasked
Morph's seconds, beats and bars switch has the same air above it as every other section of Auto play, instead of crowding the tiles above
